verdict.rationale: The evidence documents experiments that evaluate prompts, models and application code against chosen metrics, plus an SDK and an API. Nothing describes running evals in a CI pipeline or failing or blocking a deployment on eval results. The only thresholds documented belong to log alerts, which is an adjacent production-monitoring feature rather than deployment gating, so the experiment and SDK primitives are developer building blocks only.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results
